# spaceman admin

Bootstrap and break-glass administration (offline: takes the data-directory lock; needs the KEK).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman admin bootstrap`](#spaceman-admin-bootstrap) | Issue the root token once; use it to create the first administrator in the web UI (/setup) or API |
| [`spaceman admin recover`](#spaceman-admin-recover) | Break-glass: issue a one-time recovery login for a user, or create a new administrator (--new-admin) |
| [`spaceman admin root-token`](#spaceman-admin-root-token) | Manage the bootstrap root token |

## spaceman admin bootstrap

Issue the root token once; use it to create the first administrator in the web UI (/setup) or API.

```sh
spaceman admin bootstrap [flags]
```

## spaceman admin recover

Break-glass: issue a one-time recovery login for a user, or create a new administrator (--new-admin).

```sh
spaceman admin recover [user-id] [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--new-admin` | string |  | create a new administrator with this email instead |

## spaceman admin root-token

Manage the bootstrap root token.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman admin root-token rotate`](#spaceman-admin-root-token-rotate) | Revoke the active root token (if any) and issue a new one |

## spaceman admin root-token rotate

Revoke the active root token (if any) and issue a new one.

```sh
spaceman admin root-token rotate [flags]
```
